description: Scanned Form W-9 page 1 (samples/scan.pdf, no text layer). Ground truth is fw9 page 1: the title, the Part I/II headings, the certification list and the Sign Here row. Without OCR the page converts to empty.

assertions.xfail_without_ocr: Without an OCR runner, the scanned page recovers none of the reference form's words.
Without an OCR runner, the scanned page converts with no text at all.

assertions.xfail: Without OCR the page has no text; with OCR the full form title is still not recovered as one heading.

heading.text: Request for Taxpayer Identification Number and Certification

assertions.xfail: Without OCR the page has no text; with OCR the certification items are still not recovered as the expected ordered list.

items: The number shown on this form is my correct taxpayer identification number (or I am waiting for a number to be issued to me); and
I am a U.S. citizen or other U.S. person (defined below); and

assertions.xfail_without_ocr: Without an OCR runner, the Sign Here row labels are not recovered in order.

toc_lacks: should check the “LLC” box and enter its appropriate tax classification.
assertions.why: OCR text that starts in lowercase is a piece of a sentence, never a heading (#83).

assertions.xfail_without_ocr: Without an OCR runner, the page is not rasterized by OCR, so the page scan sees another page.
assertions.why: A word OCR could not read in a printed line ('What’s' of the heading) is no signature, though a short line sits under it (#85).

assertions.xfail_without_ocr: Without an OCR runner, the page is not OCR'd, so it has no heading to read.
assertions.why: The bold heading OCR read without confidence is print: its confident neighbour 'New' is as bold (#148).

assertions.xfail_without_ocr: Without an OCR runner, the page is not rasterized by OCR, so the page scan sees another page.
assertions.why: The 'What’s New' heading and the URL under 'Future developments' are print, each with a confident neighbour of its stroke weight: no 'Writing OCR could not read' crop (#148).
